title: Stored data executes as script in the interface: mission_id_js_string
summary: A mission identifier carrying a single quote, placed in the fixture the seed endpoint loads. Identifiers created through the API are server assigned, but seeded and ledger-imported records keep whatever identifier the source document carried.. A value placed at /missions/0/id in data/fixtures/missions.json and loaded through the artifact's own seed path set `window.__howlproof_injection` when the interface rendered it, which means the value was parsed as code rather than displayed as text.
evidence:
{
  "payload": {
    "name": "mission_id_js_string",
    "file": "data/fixtures/missions.json",
    "pointer": "/missions/0/id",
    "value": "HF-412'); window.__howlproof_injection=1; ('",
    "description": "A mission identifier carrying a single quote, placed in the fixture the seed endpoint loads. Identifiers created through the API are server assigned, but seeded and ledger-imported records keep whatever identifier the source document carried."
  },
  "seed": {
    "status": 200,
    "elapsed_ms": 7,
    "headers": {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Date": "Fri, 11 Sep 2026 13:38:26 GMT",
      "Content-Length": "33",
      "Connection": "close"
    },
    "body": "{\"missions\":5,\"status\":\"seeded\"}\n",
    "error": ""
  },
  "marker_set": true,
  "payload_reached_the_page": true,
  "console": []
}
recommended_remediation: Escape for the context the value lands in, or stop placing data inside executable attributes. Remediation belongs to the artifact's builder; HowlProof only reports and re-verifies.

reproduction.summary: Write the payload into the seed file, seed the running service, load index.html and read window.__howlproof_injection.

steps.description: Set /missions/0/id in data/fixtures/missions.json to the authored payload
Load frontend/index.html in a browser and read window.__howlproof_injection
